svg.title: Lemma 8.4 (A singular composite effect forces a pure output). Let Uj = im Φj. For any full-law minimal qutrit source, U0 ⊕U1 ⊕U2 = M3(C) as vector spaces: the three states in each column form a basis of Uj, and all nine states are independent. Suppose Ek has rank two, with kernel line L. Among indices j with faithful Ej, at most one effect Fjk = Φ∗ j(Ek) can be singular.
